utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can help with the repair drive. What do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That’s kind of you, Leo. If you can bring a flashlight and a few sturdy gloves, that would help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sure thing — I’ll bring a flashlight and sturdy gloves.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m a little worried about the logistics—how are we getting everything there and who’s coordinating the drop-off?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Yeah, fair question — do we have someone confirmed for the drop-off yet?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Not yet, and that’s what I’m worried about. If we don’t sort a driver and a time soon, it’s going to get messy.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — the repair drive. I might’ve missed the details, but I’m happy to help if you remind me what’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Noah — that’d really help. I’m a bit fuzzy on the details too, but I can check and get back to you.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Oren — appreciate it. Just let me know when you’ve got the details, and I’ll pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll let folks know about the repair drive and keep repeating the plan around the neighborhood.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Vik — I’ll keep an ear out and pass it along too.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, I’ll keep spreading the word and make sure the repair drive stays on everyone’s mind.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Gus, sorry I’m late—what’s the latest on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: No worries at all — we’re still good to go, and I’ve got a few tools ready if you need them.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Nice, thanks Gus. I’ll grab them and catch up with you now.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good — I like a clear plan. What’s the first thing you need me to do for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great — could you help me make the sign-up list and bring any tools you can spare? I’ll spread the word to the neighbors and keep things moving.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I can do that. I’ll make the sign-up list and bring my spare tools.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: How’s the repair drive going, Sam? Need a hand with anything?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: It’s going well, thanks, Mina. If you’ve got some time, I could use help sorting the donated tools.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sure, I can help with that. Want me to sort them by type or by condition?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sure thing — I can help spread the word and connect folks for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Jules — I’ll keep track of who’s where and make sure folks know where to go.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great, thanks — I’ll check in with my two circles and pass along the details so everyone knows where to show up.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Mara — could you help me track the needed supplies and check in with a few neighbors? I’ll send you the list and keep everything organized.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely, Rosa — send me the list and I’ll start tracking the supplies and checking in with neighbors.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can help keep an eye on the supplies for the repair drive. What do you still need?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, Cleo — we still need tape, screwdrivers, and a few extension cords. I’ll send the full list over.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Got it — I’ll watch for tape, screwdrivers, and extension cords. Send the full list when you can.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is getting a pretty good turnout already. If you want, I can pass along the details too.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Tess. I’d appreciate that.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sure thing — it’s happening this Saturday at the community center, and they’re asking for tools, spare parts, and a few volunteers. I can send you the full list if you’d like.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it — I’ll check the details before we do anything. What’s the repair drive issue?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: The repair drive’s just over by the school lot, and I’m trying to line it up with pickup times so it doesn’t get in the way. If you can check the details, I’d really appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’ll verify the pickup times and the school lot details first, then I’ll get back to you.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — what do you need from me for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Just help spread the word and bring anything small you can spare for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure thing — I’ll spread the word and bring something small if I can.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m going to spread the word about the repair drive and keep folks posted on the details.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Vik — that’ll really help. I’ll keep sharing updates too so everyone stays in the loop.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll keep repeating the plan and let people know as details come in.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right—the repair drive. I’m a bit out of the loop, but I’m here to help if you need me.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Noah. I appreciate that—I'm just trying to get the list in order and make sure we don’t miss anything.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it—I can help keep an eye out for anything missing. Just tell me what you need next.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I haven’t heard the details yet—what kind of repair drive is it?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: It’s a neighborhood repair drive—folks bring in broken stuff like lamps, bikes, and small appliances, and we help fix what we can.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That sounds useful—where and when is it happening?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely, Opal — I’m ready to help organize the repair drive and keep everything on track. Tell me what you’d like to tackle first.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Let’s start by listing the repair spots and who’s covering each one, then we can note any supplies we still need.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Sounds good — I’ll start the list of repair spots and match each one with a volunteer. Then I’ll flag any supplies we’re short on.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can help, but I’m a little worried about the timing and who’s handling the drop-offs. Do we have the route and a clear list of what needs to go?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll send the route and the drop-off list right over, and I can help coordinate who’s taking what.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, that would help a lot. Once I have the route and list, I’ll feel better about lining up the drop-offs.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, this repair drive is still happening, right?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes, it’s still happening — let me just double-check the details before we move ahead.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great, thanks — can you confirm the time and where we’re meeting?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sure thing — I like to keep it simple. Let’s make a clear plan for the repair drive and stick to it.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good — I might show up a little late, but I’m in for the repair drive and I’ll help where I can.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: No problem, Dane. Just come when you can, and I’ll keep the plan steady so you can jump in wherever needed.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard the repair drive’s getting organized, but I’m still catching up on the details. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’m keeping an eye on supplies—if you can, bring any spare tape, batteries, or tools you’ve got. I’ll make sure they get to the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I can do that—I’ve got some spare tape and a couple of batteries I can bring by. Just tell me when and where to drop them off.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive. I was just thinking I should check what still needs doing and bring by whatever I can.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That’d be great, Oren—just swing by and we’ll match you up with what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sounds good—I’ll come by soon and see what I can take care of.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around the school schedule for the repair drive—what time are you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Late afternoon would work best for me—around 4:30, after school pickup. If that’s too tight, I can do 5:00 instead.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: 4:30 should work—I can plan around pickup and confirm the details.
